title: Jim Cramer warns AI investors about hidden leverage trap
excerpt: Jim Cramer urged investors to stop using borrowed money for artificial intelligence stocks as U.S. margin debt climbed above $1.5 trillion. A lot of the bigg...
content_html:
Faizan Farooque

Fri, July 31, 2026 at 8:07 PM PDT 5 min read

Jim Cramer urged investors to stop using borrowed money for artificial intelligence stocks as U.S. margin debt climbed above $1.5 trillion.

A lot of the biggest advances in the industry have been in AI infrastructure. Jim Cramer thinks investors who are borrowing to pursue those returns are taking an unacceptable risk.

The CNBC "Mad Money" host urged viewers to get out of data-center investments bought on margin, saying the group is now too dangerous to buy on margin because of the uncertainty about how much AI spending will last.

"If you're borrowing money to buy something related to the data center, then tomorrow morning, 9:30 a.m., sell it no matter what," Cramer said on the July 27 edition of "Mad Money." "You won't regret it."

His warning comes as investors have leveraged up even more against their brokerage accounts.

The Financial Industry Regulatory Authority said debit balances in customer securities margin accounts hit $1.502 trillion in June. That was up 49% from $1.008 trillion a year ago and up 6.1% from May.

The surge doesn't mean all the borrowed money went into AI stocks. But it does indicate that investors have considerably greater leveraged market exposure at a time when data center shares are becoming less predictable.

For shareholders, such a combination produces a dangerous feedback loop. Falling prices might lead to forced sales, which can then drive prices lower and lead to further margin calls.

Cramer's message is therefore narrower than "sell technology." Those investors who possess high-quality equities without leverage are able to weather a slump. Those who are borrowing to enhance their exposure may have little say in when or how their positions are sold.

Rising margin debt sharpens Cramer's AI warning

Buying on margin allows investors to buy more stock than they could if they just used cash.

Under Federal Reserve Regulation T, brokerage companies are normally permitted to loan customers up to 50% of the purchase price of an eligible stock. FINRA rules generally mandate that investors maintain equity in their accounts equal to at least 25% of the value of long securities in the account.

Some brokerage businesses may have more stringent standards, such as maintenance levels of 30% or 40%. They can potentially increase those requirements in moments of market instability.

Related: Alphabet's biggest AI fear may be fading

This means that an investor can get a margin call without making any more trades.

The Securities and Exchange Commission warns that brokers can sell stocks without talking to the customer, and investors may not be able to determine which holdings will be sold. Losses can sometimes exceed the initial investment.

content_html_zh:
费赞·法鲁克

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 7 月 31 日星期五晚上 8:07 阅读 5 分钟

随着美国保证金债务攀升至 1.5 万亿美元以上，吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 敦促投资者停止使用借来的资金购买人工智能股票。

该行业许多最大的进步都体现在人工智能基础设施上。 吉姆·克莱默认为，为追求回报而借贷的投资者正在冒不可接受的风险。

CNBC“Mad Money”主持人敦促观众停止以保证金购买的数据中心投资，称该集团现在太危险，无法以保证金购买，因为人工智能支出将持续多少存在不确定性。

“如果你借钱购买与数据中心相关的东西，那么明天早上 9 点 30 分，无论如何都要卖掉它，”克莱默在 7 月 27 日版的《Mad Money》中说道。 “你不会后悔的。”

他发出警告之际，投资者已经加大了经纪账户的杠杆力度。

金融业监管局表示，6 月份客户证券保证金账户的借方余额达到 1.502 万亿美元。 比一年前的 1.008 万亿美元增长 49%，比 5 月份增长 6.1%。

飙升并不意味着所有借来的钱都投入了人工智能股票。 但这确实表明，在数据中心股票变得越来越难以预测的情况下，投资者的杠杆市场敞口要大得多。

对于股东来说，这种组合会产生危险的反馈循环。 价格下跌可能会导致强制出售，从而导致价格下跌并导致进一步追加保证金。

因此，克莱默的信息范围比“销售技术”要窄。 那些拥有优质股票而无需杠杆的投资者能够经受住低迷的考验。 那些借钱来增加风险敞口的人可能对何时或如何出售其头寸几乎没有发言权。

利润率债务上升加剧了克莱默的人工智能警告

与仅使用现金相比，以保证金购买可以让投资者购买更多的股票。

根据美联储 T 条例，经纪公司通常可以向客户提供高达合格股票购买价格 50% 的贷款。 FINRA 规则通常要求投资者在其账户中维持至少等于账户中多头证券价值的 25% 的权益。

一些经纪业务可能有更严格的标准，例如30%或40%的维持水平。 在市场不稳定的时刻，他们可能会增加这些要求。

相关：Alphabet 对人工智能最大的恐惧可能正在消退

这意味着投资者无需进行任何更多交易即可收到追加保证金通知。

美国证券交易委员会警告说，经纪人可以在不与客户交谈的情况下出售股票，投资者可能无法确定将出售哪些股票。 损失有时可能超过初始投资。
